jobs.title: Part-Time Music Teacher
jobs.description:
Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.
ROLE SUMMARY:

The International School of Ticino is seeking an enthusiastic and talented Part-Time Music Teacher to join the school from August 2026.

The successful candidate will deliver engaging and inspiring Music lessons across the Secondary School, encouraging students to develop their musical knowledge, performance skills and creativity. This role would suit a passionate educator who can foster a love of music while contributing to the wider cultural life of the school.

About the School

The International School of Ticino (IST), part of the Inspired Education Group, is a growing international school offering a high-quality education within a modern and supportive environment.

The school delivers the International Baccalaureate (IB) programmes, fostering creativity, academic excellence and international mindedness. IST provides students with a broad educational experience that encourages them to develop confidence, curiosity and a lifelong appreciation for the arts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Teach Music across the Secondary School, including IB programmes where appropriate

• Plan and deliver engaging, practical and student-centred lessons

• Develop students' musical understanding, performance skills and creativity

• Prepare students for performances, concerts and other musical events

• Differentiate learning to meet the needs of all students

• Monitor student progress and provide clear, constructive feedback

• Contribute to curriculum development within the Music department

• Support extracurricular music activities, ensembles and performances where appropriate

• Collaborate with colleagues to promote the performing arts across the school

• Engage positively with parents and the wider school community

• Uphold safeguarding and child protection procedures at all times

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

Essential

• A degree in Music or a related field

• A recognised teaching qualification

• Experience teaching Music at secondary level

• Strong practical musicianship and subject knowledge

• Excellent communication and classroom management skills

• A passion for music education and student development

• A collaborative and student-centred approach

• EU passport (essential requirement)

Desirable

• Experience teaching within the IB MYP and/or DP

• Experience in an international school environment

• Ability to lead choirs, ensembles or instrumental groups

• Experience organising performances, productions or musical events

• Familiarity with music technology and digital composition tools

SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT:

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

La ricerca è aperta anche a candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99 (collocamento mirato delle persone con disabilità).

This opportunity is also open to candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99 (targeted employment of persons with disabilities).

Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com

The International School of Ticino (IST) is part of the Inspired Education Group, one of the world's leading premium school groups. Located in Lugano, IST offers a stimulating international learning environment in Ticino.
